descripcion_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a AI Trainers Network - Greek based in France.

This opportunity is designed for Greek-speaking contributors interested in helping shape the development of safer, smarter, and more human-centered AI systems.
Rather than a single active position, it provides access to a talent network for future remote projects in AI data and language services.
Depending on your skills, you may contribute to annotation, evaluation, prompt creation, or linguistic and cultural quality assurance.
Projects can involve text, images, audio, search results, advertisements, chatbots, or large language model outputs.
You’ll work flexibly and receive project-specific information about the scope, timeline, tasks, and compensation before deciding whether to participate.
The role is well suited to detail-oriented, curious contributors who are comfortable with digital tools and interested in emerging AI technologies.
By joining the network, you can access a range of flexible remote opportunities as projects aligned with your skills become available.


Accountabilities:
  • Annotate and label text, images, audio, or other content to support the development and training of AI systems.
  • Evaluate search results, advertisements, chatbot responses, or other AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Create, test, and refine prompts designed to improve the performance of large language models.
  • Review content for Greek linguistic, cultural, and contextual accuracy.
  • Help ensure AI systems produce more accurate, inclusive, natural, and human-centered results.
  • Follow project-specific instructions, quality standards, timelines, and workflows.
  • Adapt to different project types and levels of complexity depending on skills, availability, and project requirements.
  • Review project details and independently determine which opportunities align with your availability and interests.

    • Requirements:

    • Native or near-native fluency in Greek.
    • The original project network specifies Greece as the base location; candidates should verify eligibility for the specific opportunity they are applying to.
    • Proficiency in English sufficient to understand project instructions and communicate effectively.
    • Comfortable using digital tools and working with online platforms.
    • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies, inaccuracies, or quality issues.
    • Curiosity about technology, artificial intelligence, language, and digital content.
    • Ability to follow detailed guidelines and consistently apply project-specific requirements.
    • Strong linguistic, cultural, or subject-matter awareness relevant to assigned projects is advantageous.
    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage tasks according to agreed timelines.

      • Benefits:

      • Access to a global contributor network supporting AI development projects.
      • Flexible, remote project opportunities that can be completed on your own terms.
      • Ability to choose whether to participate when a project matching your skills and availability becomes available.
      • Exposure to AI annotation, evaluation, prompt creation, and large language model projects.
      • Opportunity to contribute to more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI systems.
      • Project-specific details, timelines, scope, and compensation provided before participation.
      • Opportunities that can range from short assignments lasting a few days to projects extending over several weeks.
      • Global and diverse community of contributors working across AI-related initiatives.
      • Potential to develop experience working with emerging AI technologies and digital workflows.
